_note: Upgrade offers (Yusuf's pick 2026-10-22): a blueprint draft may offer one of these (at most upgrade_cards a draft, data/balance.json) for a building the town has standing. Taking it spends the draft and changes that building for the rest of the run, every one of it, built or still to come. add = numbers added to the building's data in data/buildings.json, by key; a dotted key reaches inside (lodging.beds). Each upgrade can be taken once. rarity = data/rarity.json (offer weight). sim/build_hand.gd (offers, draft_upgrade), RunState.take_upgrade.
